يدلهم (form IVq)
# يَدْلَهِمُّ (yadlahimmu) /jad.la.him.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# يَدْلَهِمَّ (yadlahimma) /jad.la.him.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# يَدْلَهِمِّ (yadlahimmi) /jad.la.him.mi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِدْلَهَمَّ
